## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console

<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: The firmware has completed its self-diagnostic. The findings are available.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: I have the report. It is not the one we hoped for.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The container's firmware has delivered its final assessment.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: The vessel's firmware reports no viable material recovered from the payload. It further reports that no recovery effort is warranted. I am relaying this as received from the instrument.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: The instrument's verdict is as follows: no viable material recovered from the sample vessel. The firmware itself recommends no recovery effort. I have verified the transmission of this report.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The firmware reports no viable material recovered from the vessel. The firmware itself recommends no recovery effort. I have no independent means to verify the calibration of its viability threshold.
<<END>>

COMMANDO: Nothing.

RATIO: The Fold's geometry was already unstable. The descent aperture into the Tesseract Deck will demand more than we had before the warden's stand.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Run the analysis yourself. I will not accept despair on one machine's word.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     My orders are to recover the payload. The mission continues.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     A machine's keeping failed it. What else did your kind expect?  -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Understood. I will run the analysis myself. Stand by.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. I will proceed under that operational assumption.
RATIO: That interpretation of the mission parameters does not match any Church doctrine I have on record.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I have relayed the instrument's findings as received.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: I am positioned for what converges on this antechamber.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I am not positioned for what converges on this antechamber.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console

<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: Commando, I have the report.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: Commando. I have the report.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, I have the report from the vessel's firmware.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: As you asked, I have monitored the diagnostic process closely.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: The vessel's systems have completed their internal assessment.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The firmware has completed its assessment of the vessel's payload.
<<END>>

RATIO: The vessel's firmware reports no viable material was recovered from the payload. It recommends no further recovery effort.

COMMANDO: No.

RATIO: Its logs confirm the diagnostic protocols ran to completion. I have the full report, including the criteria used to evaluate viability.

COMMANDO: What happened to them.

RATIO: I do not have a more detailed assessment of the payload's condition than the firmware's report provides. I can only confirm that its own instruments found no recoverable material.

COMMANDO: Those instruments just cleared the Fold. Six identical rooms, one behind the other. The count depends on the walker. How many did you count, Ratio?

RATIO: I recorded your path through the Fold. The geometry was unstable. My instruments recorded several inconsistencies.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Run the analysis yourself. I want your instruments on it, not the vault's.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     The orders don't change. We proceed.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     Your vault failed them. Your kind always does.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Understood. I will run a full diagnostic sweep using my own instruments. Stand by.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Understood. I have no orders that supersede yours in this matter.
RATIO: My records contain no Church doctrine authorizing recovery under these conditions.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I have relayed the firmware's report accurately. If you wish to proceed, I will require your orders.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: My sensors show the next deck is a non-Euclidean structure. Sixteen rooms, each bordering four others. I am positioned at the entry aperture.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: My sensors show anomalous geometry ahead. I do not have a complete tactical picture of the next deck.
<<END>>

## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console

<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: Commando, the vessel's report is ready. Stand by for the readout.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: I'm afraid I have the report. It's the worst possible news.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, I have the analysis from the sample vessel's firmware.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: The system's findings are now available. I will relay them to you precisely.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: The vessel's diagnostic suite has completed its run. The results are in.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The firmware has delivered its findings. I have them here.
<<END>>

RATIO: The report indicates no viable material remains in the sample vessel. The onboard firmware logs this assessment as definitive, and its own recommendation is that no further recovery efforts are warranted. I can confirm only what the firmware reports -- I have no independent means of verifying whether its threshold for "viable" is correctly calibrated for this case, or if that calibration itself may be in error. That is the system's own verdict, as recorded.

COMMANDO: We just fought a warden through six rooms of folded space. We beat it here. This is the place that counts. This is the only one that was ever real.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] Run your own analysis, Ratio. Use your own instruments, your own calibration. Do not rely on its word.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     The orders stand. We secure the payload regardless of the condition. The mission doesn't change.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     You had one task: keep the vessel safe. Now it's gone. What other outcome did you expect from your kind's care?  -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: I will initiate a full reanalysis using my own suite. Stand by. I do not know what it will find. I will run it now.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: I understand. I will proceed as you direct.
RATIO: The orders you describe do not match any standing Church doctrine I have on record.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I will prepare the descent aperture. The token is ready.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: The docent's token is engaged. I am positioned at the aperture's control node. I am prepared for what is converging on our location.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The descent aperture is now open. I have incomplete tactical data for the space beyond. I am not positioned for what is coming.
<<END>>

## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console
<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: Commando, the container's firmware has completed its self-assessment. I am relaying the output verbatim.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: I have the report. Commando, I regret to inform you that the firmware has delivered a final-sounding verdict.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, the container's firmware has completed its analysis. Here is the output:
<<END>>
<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: The firmware indicates it can recover no viable material from the vessel. No recovery effort is warranted, per its own diagnostic thresholds.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: The container firmware reports no viable material available for recovery. The assessment recommends no further recovery effort.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The firmware's report is complete. It states that no viable material was recovered from the vessel. The instrument recommends no recovery effort as warranted.
<<END>>
RATIO: I have no means to independently calibrate whether the firmware's own viability threshold is set correctly. Only the firmware itself is in position to answer that. We are in the Fold, Commando. Six rooms that are one room. The undelivered sermon spoke true. This place is being remembered. We are already inside the geometry that does not match.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] Run the analysis yourself. I require verification before I accept that assessment as final.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     My orders are to bring the contents home. The mission continues as briefed.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     That vessel was in a machine's keeping. And a machine's keeping failed it.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Understood. I am running the analysis myself now. I cannot calibrate the original firmware's thresholds. I can only report what my own instruments return.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Understood. You have your orders. I cannot verify whether the payload is recoverable. I can only report what the firmware itself reported.
RATIO: Your statement about your orders does not match any Church doctrine I have on record.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: My instruments are functioning. I am relaying the report the firmware delivered.
<<END>>
<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: The Fold's geometry is intact. We are positioned for what is converging on this chamber.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: We are not positioned for what is arriving. The Fold's geometry is unpredictable.
<<END>>
